The idea behind SneakyHard

How much challenge can fit into the fewest possible pieces and rules?

That question drives SneakyHard: tiny boards, small sets of pieces and simple mechanics that you can grasp at a glance — and think about for a long time.

The ambition is to bring AI and machine learning together with human logic, intuition and careful testing. Explore possibilities, uncover hidden traps, play, and refine. Every piece and every rule should earn its place.
